entries.title: Psalms 128:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of Ascents.>> Blessed [is] every one who fears the LORD, Who walks in His ways.

entries.title: Psalms 128:2
segments: When you eat the labor of your hands, You [shall be] happy, and [it shall be] well with you.

entries.title: Psalms 128:3
segments: Your wife [shall be] like a fruitful vine In the very heart of your house, Your children like olive plants All around your table.

entries.title: Psalms 128:4
segments: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed Who fears the LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 128:5
segments: The LORD bless you out of Zion, And may you see the good of Jerusalem All the days of your life.

entries.title: Psalms 128:6
segments: Yes, may you see your children's children. Peace [be] upon Israel!
